decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording quick, preferably tool-free whisk detachment for cleaning; no additional update or removal is required.

Quick whisk detachment does not change the selected whisk-head style, material, size, powder compatibility, or positioning criterion. The same-message positioning change is already independently represented.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY requiring bowl-removal clearance from the whisk and motor assembly. The quick whisk-detachment decision does not necessarily add another bowl-removal attribute.
Whisk detachment behavior does not alter the candidate's splash targets or control methods; splash control is addressed by separate clauses concerning positioning, bowl geometry, or a guard.
The source adds a specific whisk-removal usability constraint but does not modify the general event-use reliability requirement.
Quick tool-free whisk removal does not change the required mixing result or high-speed smoothness behavior.
The whisk-removal decision does not change maximum motor speed, adjustment range, or normal speed-use constraints.
The client specifies desired detachment behavior but does not decide whether its mechanism must be off-the-shelf or custom, so propagation would require an additional design decision.
Whisk detachment for cleaning and swapping does not change dispensing flow, froth preservation, sputtering, or the dispensing sequence.
The source does not necessarily change enclosure size, side profile, or bowl-well form; any packaging solution for the removable whisk remains an implementation choice.
Quick whisk removal does not modify bowl capacity, form, size reference, or capacity-selection priorities.
The whisk-removal decision is unrelated to spout location, orientation, geometry, or fabrication style.
